title: American Truck Simulator
provenance: Reported by glkmag (highball-db#233, 2026-09-27), Apple M4, macOS 27.0, Highball 0.9.35, engine x64-crossover26.3-r4 (an early Wine 11 engine), DXMT, rated 4 of 5 after 7 minutes, said to run almost as well as on CrossOver. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Reported playable on DXMT on the Wine 11 engine r4. Two issues reported: Quit Game freezes the screen and the game has to be closed from Highball, and a custom ESP32 Bluetooth controller is not recognised. Nothing was measured here. The game has a native Mac version on Steam as well.

knownIssues.symptom: Quit Game freezes the screen instead of exiting (reported on an M4, DXMT, engine x64-crossover26.3-r4).
knownIssues.fix: close the game from Highball. Not yet tried on the current engines.

knownIssues.symptom: A custom ESP32 Bluetooth game controller is not recognised (reported on an M4).
knownIssues.cause: not measured. A controller Wine's raw HID path does not map is the case the SDL driver handles.
knownIssues.fix: worth trying the dependency "Controllers through SDL" (recipe controller-sdl), then restart the environment. Not verified for this controller.
